## Outcome
What should the player or developer be able to do?

## Starting point
Rule or source file, build revision, and current behavior.

## Pass condition
One observable check. Say whether it needs the editor or a physical Quest.

## Session handoff
Branch and commit, result, outstanding decision, next small action.
